audio_access.limitation: Could not listen to the AAC stream in this review context; burned-in captions were used for dialogue-dependent evidence.

uncertainty: Audio and narration delivery could not be assessed. Prepared prototype states do not establish real user activity, live model calls, or deployed integrations.

technical_depth.evidence_type: film-visible interactive prototype flow; no backend or live API inference

evidence.observation: Opening text: ‘I can’t tell my family what I want.’
Promise: think privately, correct the reflection, choose whether to explore peer experiences; adult family-pressure audience appears by about 0:15.
Arjun can reject or edit a possible reading and replace it with his own words.
The next step remains optional and the family decision is explicitly unresolved.
Muse Spark is identified as planned for organizing a correctable reflection; no model is connected.
Prepared peer, host, and moderator roles are described; no live people or moderation are connected.
Quiet opening gives the dilemma a brief emotional beat.
Long screen captures and scrolling carry most of the film; burned captions are readable in sampled frames but overlap lower page content at times.

film_persuasion.audio_limitation: AAC present but not audibly accessible; captions used, so narration, audio quality, and audio-led pacing are unassessed.

model_attribution.proposed_role: Could help organize a reflection that Arjun can correct; optional voice transcription is also described as planned.
model_attribution.substantiated: The film-visible UI shows an editable possible interpretation and user correction controls.
model_attribution.not_substantiated: No model is connected; the preview states it uses prepared local rules. No model execution credit awarded.

fix_tickets.issue: Audience and product promise arrive after the opening line.
fix_tickets.replacement: Put ‘For adults facing family pressure’ and the private/correctable/optional-peer promise in the opening beat.
fix_tickets.verification: Ask a cold viewer to summarize audience, problem, and promise after 15 seconds.

fix_tickets.issue: The correction transition is easy to miss at playback speed.
fix_tickets.replacement: Hold and visibly show ‘Not quite’ leading to the edited wording.
fix_tickets.expected_result: The user’s agency reads as an action.
fix_tickets.verification: Viewer can explain what changed and who chose it.

fix_tickets.issue: Prepared community status competes with dense content.
fix_tickets.replacement: Focus on ‘prepared historical posts,’ ‘no live activity,’ and the unresolved thread before audience preview.
fix_tickets.expected_result: Peer value and limits are both clear.
fix_tickets.verification: Viewer does not mistake prepared content for live testimonials.

fix_tickets.issue: Sharing safeguards are small in the full form view.
fix_tickets.replacement: Zoom through exact audience, alias, question, excluded private context, and unchecked consent.
fix_tickets.expected_result: Consent scope is legible without pausing.
fix_tickets.verification: Viewer can state what is shared and excluded.

fix_tickets.issue: Ending repeats the walkthrough instead of landing the human payoff.
fix_tickets.replacement: Close on the private ‘ask for time’ takeaway beside the optional unsent draft and unresolved decision.
fix_tickets.expected_result: Memorable agency without implying resolution or live support.
fix_tickets.verification: Viewer recalls the takeaway and its limits.
